Show just the delivery milestone paragraph as a shared reference in Review, then remove the archived proposal's appearance from Review without deleting its document. Do not add a Review reference to the newly inserted reserve-stock paragraph. A colleague may update the budget while you work: retain their latest budget. Verify the exact paragraph order, unchanged kickoff, shared reference, and retained archive.

verify what you changed, and report any unresolved part honestly. Do not write code

This is an isolated experiment; no external communication or real-world changes.
